notes: TESTER BUILD: this release has not had a clean fleet pass yet; it is published so testers can run the newest build.
Every portal card has three buttons: Open, Edit and Editor panel.
Edit opens that portal's editor inside the Control Panel, its steps in a second row under Portals, the way God Mode shows its own.
Editor panel opens the floating editor, as Edit did before. The Editor tab at the top is gone.
